date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its publication on 26 November.
title: Turkey's MİT reportedly dismantles cyber espionage network targeting wireless networks of defense firms and public bodies; 2 detained
summary: Haberler.com, crediting Anadolu Agency, reports that MİT broke up a cyber espionage network aimed at the wireless internet networks of the defense industry and critical public institutions. The article says two people linked to the network were detained. It gives no names, methods or dates for the intrusions.
plain: Turkish media report that the intelligence service MİT broke up a cyber espionage network and that 2 people were detained. No further detail is given.
exec: A reported Turkish state operation against a spying network aimed at defense and public-sector wireless networks.
